metadata.article_title: Previous judgments relevant to bar a second suit or trial

article.title: Previous judgments relevant to bar a second suit or trial
article.content:
34Previous judgments relevant to bar a second suit or trial

Section 34 · Part II · Chapter II · Judgments of Courts when relevant
The existence of any judgment, order or decree which by law prevents any Court from taking cognizance of a suit or holding a trial, is a relevant fact when the question is whether such Court ought to take cognizance of such suit or to hold such trial.
